text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected for gateway-service in eu-west-1. rolling 5m error rate = 7.8% (baseline 0.3%). paging oncall. alert link: https://telemetry.redwood/alerts/2166004321 :rotating_light:

alana_oncall: I'm on it. acked. quick check — is this a deploy window?

mike_sre: Not that I'm aware of. No recent deploys to gateway clusters in last 30m. looking at logs now.

alana_oncall: looking at ingress logs, seeing lots of upstream 502/503 from gateway -> edge-proxy. sample: `502 Bad Gateway` and `upstream read timeout` for requests with large fanout.

chao_infra: pulling cluster metrics. Connections to model-service pods in eu-west-1 are high and CPU on the model pool is at 95% on a subset of nodes. KV cache misses spiked too.

elaine_prod: putting status page draft: "Partial degradation in EU region for some API calls; retries may succeed." Do we have an immediate customer impact estimate?

mike_sre: initial estimate: ~3.9% of total customer requests got 5xx, peak lasted ~12m. Mostly generation endpoints with long context lengths. Affects some paid production tenants but limited by region.

alana_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) reduce fanout from gateway to model-service for heavy requests 2) enable circuit-breaker / short-circuit for customers over X rps 3) route a small % of traffic to eu-central fallback pool. Who can flip feature flag for fanout?

chao_infra: I can toggle the gateway feature-flag to reduce parallelism. command: ```bash
# toggle fanout limit
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://config.redwood/flags/gateway.reduce_fanout -d '{"value":true}'
```

alana_oncall: doing it now. ✅

incident-bot: config change applied by chao_infra. new fanout limit = 2 per request.

mike_sre: after fanout reduction, 5xx dropped to 2.1% within 2m. still above baseline but much better. Starting a targeted traffic shift: route 10% -> eu-central fallback pool.

chao_infra: routing rule applied via traffic-orch: ```yaml
- match: region == eu-west-1 && route == /v1/generate
  action: route_weight(eu-central:10, eu-west-1:90)
```

alana_oncall: routing applied. telemetry shows error rate down to 0.6% and latency improving. Good.

elaine_prod: updating status: "Mitigation in progress: traffic steering and gateway throttles applied; errors decreasing. Third-party models may be impacted." :thumbsup:

jon_sales: any high profile customers impacted? need to loop in account reps if SLA risks.

mike_sre: looking at logs for tenant ids — a couple of mid-market customers saw increased retries but no data loss. I'll privately DM list to support.

alana_oncall: summary for pager: root cause likely model-service CPU/kv-cache pressure triggered upstream timeouts amplified by gateway fanout. Immediate mitigations: fanout limit + partial traffic shift + short-circuit policy.

ops-runbook-bot: runbook check: existing 'gateway-5xx-spike' playbook matched. missing step: explicit traffic-shift recipe for fallback region.

alana_oncall: action items (short term): [A1] create hotfix PR to add auto-fanout-limiter at gateway (assign mike_sre) [A2] add traffic-shift snippet to runbook (assign chao_infra) [A3] tune 5xx alert to ignore short <5m spikes under 5% to reduce noisy paging (assign elaine_prod) [A4] customer comms list for affected tenants (assign jon_sales).

mike_sre: opened hotfix branch and small patch to enforce per-request fanout cap with immediate rollback safety. PR: https://git.redwood/p/gateway/merge_requests/4321

chao_infra: drafting runbook PR for traffic-shift snippet. will include yaml templates and `traffic-orch` commands.

elaine_prod: I'll propose alert tuning change: new rule -> page if 5m error rate > 6% OR sustained >3% for 15m. putting a draft in #ops-alerts for review.

jon_sales: preparing list of affected customers and will coordinate outreach if we see SLA risk beyond the hour.

alana_oncall: final status: mitigations effective, oncall handing to overnight (mike_sre) in 30m. please post updates to this thread if any regressions.

mike_sre: taking handoff. I'll monitor for 3h and validate patch in prod canary. tagging follow-ups in GH.

incident-bot: incident resolved for now. Please close when follow-ups complete. :white_check_mark:
